tools.name: check_text
tools.description: Decide whether a text should be allowed: profanity, slurs, threats and sexual language, including disguised spellings. Returns the action (allow, review, block), the evidence, a one-sentence reason and a censored version. Use context "username" for names shown publicly.

tools.name: check_batch
tools.description: Check up to 100 texts at once. Each item has an id and a text; results come back in order.

tools.name: get_integration_snippet
tools.description: A complete, runnable recipe for adding Unprofane to a platform (supabase, clerk, firebase, auth0, better-auth, unity, godot, or plain http) in a language.
